title: Acceptance probability of a quadratic PCPP system
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb F_2$ in $n$ variables, let $w\in\{0,1\}^n$ be an input, and let $p$ be a Boolean proof indexed by the disjoint proof table of size $2^n+2^{n^2}$. The acceptance probability of the verifier that chooses uniformly among the three component tests—the quadratic-pair test, the system test, and the input-consistency test—is the arithmetic mean of the three component tests’ acceptance probabilities on $(w,p)$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations
